name: ScanBox local vision pack (Florence-2-large)
notes: Installed into engines\vision\florence2-large so it can coexist
alongside the smaller Florence-2-base pack; switch between installed
sizes from the 'Photo/document model' choice at the top of Settings
> AI - no manual file swapping needed.
Larger, more accurate sibling of the built-in Florence-2-base pack
(~1.06GB vs ~355MB). Same runtime, same code path (ONNX Runtime
in-process, ScanBox's Florence-2 engine) - just bigger encoder/decoder
weights. No new Python packages needed beyond what Florence-2-base
already requires ('onnxruntime', 'tokenizers').
Still a fixed-prompt model, not instructable chat-style - same caption
or read-text behaviour as base, just usually more accurate.
Slower per-image than base (bigger matrices to run through), but still
CPU/ONNX-based rather than llama.cpp - expect noticeably longer than
base but nowhere near as slow as the Qwen3-VL-2B pack was.
This pack was integrated without being able to test-run it against the
real model weights (network restrictions in the build environment).
The code path was verified with a mocked 12-layer decoder to confirm
the dynamic layer-count detection works, and the user has since
reported real results (a memorial-plaque photo) that were noticeably
more accurate than base - single beer can correctly counted, dog
figurines correctly identified, plaque text close to the original.
